contract_basis: Equal valid duplicates allowed; contradictory shared valid components fail; do not stitch partial vectors. This requires conflict detection across raw valid witnesses, independently of selected complete-vector projection.
hypothesis: _admit! compares only the selected row. An ignored partial witness loses a valid component, so a later partial/complete witness can contradict that component without comparison.
required_verification: Owner-run harmless generated cases after current source guard closes; positive-first equal hidden component, then changed component. Retain exact exception/disposition before any source change.
source_reasoning: After X1/Ymissing first row, Xmissing/Y2 shares no valid component and is discarded. Third Xmissing/Y3 or completeX1/Y3 is checked only against retained X1, so source appears to accept despite rawY2/Y3 conflict.
